result:
Fixed! The bug was on line 14 of `invoicing/money.py`. The function was computing whether the input was negative (line 7-9) but never applying that sign to the returned value.

**The fix:** Changed `return paise` to `return -paise if neg else paise`

Now `to_paise("-20.50")` correctly returns `-2050` instead of `2050`.

**All tests pass** ✓ (10/10 passed)
